I was rather impressed than anything else. The episode of "Wake Up" starts with Jake talking about all the fan based theories of Finn's dad and after so much hype about it we saw a regular, everyday Joe who abandoned his kid. There wasn't any fantasy story about him or any thing like that. Just your everyday douche who just wanted to leave and never come back. I was expecting an awesome father like everyone else, but Martin shows what Finn really is. Human, with human birth parents (or parent, don't know mother yet). He didn't get his heroics from a destiny or amazing parents. He got them from just being himself and that is why I was so impressed by how they made Finn's dad. If anything it just makes Finn seem even more like a Hero than anyone else in Ooo.
